name: cherami
description: Give recurring agent work its own email address to receive correspondence, prepare drafts and send authorized replies.

interface.shortDescription: An email inbox for your agent
interface.longDescription: Give ongoing project work its own email address. Find correspondence and attachments, follow conversations, save drafts and send authorized replies. Cherami handles email; your connected agent works on it with its own tools. Sign in and approve access to connect your Cherami account.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up an email address for my agent.
Summarize the latest messages in my Cherami inbox.
Find the latest email with an attachment and summarize it.
